method: Interactive official web documentation reads; no bulk record retrieval, paid search or API generation.

checks.supports: Match review must distinguish identity, list/program, transaction, restrictions and authorizations. Names and addresses alone may mislead.
checks.does_not_establish: Identity of any candidate, any specific violation, or applicability to an actual transaction.

checks.supports: Compliance scope includes US persons, with program-specific definitions and some provisions affecting non-US persons.
checks.does_not_establish: A US nexus or other applicable restriction for a generated source pair.

checks.supports: OFAC explains indirect ownership and aggregation under its 50 Percent Rule; simple multiplication of arbitrary paths is unsafe.
checks.does_not_establish: Ownership percentages in any Rabbit source or blocking of any particular unlisted entity.

checks.supports: Control alone does not create automatic blocking under the ownership rule; other program provisions can matter.
checks.does_not_establish: That a controlled entity is unrestricted under all possible authorities.

checks.supports: Official service provides SDN and non-SDN downloads and published delta archives.
checks.availability_level: documentation_only; endpoint fields/history coverage not sampled

checks.supports: Official endpoint index documents unauthenticated endpoints including recipient lookup, awards and transactions.
checks.availability_level: documentation_only; no award endpoint execution or coverage verification

checks.supports: TRI concerns covered toxic chemicals, sectors and reporting thresholds; completeness must be qualified.
checks.availability_level: documentation_only; no common methane measure established

checks.supports: Parent relationships are accounting-consolidation relationships; do not treat them as voting or ownership percentages.
Ownership-rule FAQ index checked alongside individual FAQs 398 and 401.
OFAC match-assessment FAQ collection checked alongside FAQ 5.
GHG reporting/data program exists; page flags changing reporting rules and deadlines. No current year legal scope asserted.
Vessel identity/activity APIs documented; registration, API key, terms and attribution required. No access credentials requested.
Documentation landing page reached; substantive field evidence instead comes from the separately logged small API response.

access_failures.reason: Git had no configured credential helper; no username available.
access_failures.resolution: Read-only GitHub CLI authentication check succeeded; command-scoped gh credential helper enabled authenticated remote read. No token recorded.
No escalation; used command-scoped credential helper instead.

coverage_limit: Every other catalog source is unverified. A successful documentation read is not successful record access or permission for bulk reuse.
